title: Social cognition: inference about inference
summary: Agents as planners; inferring goals, preferences, knowledge and beliefs by inverting a generative model of rational action; nested inference; communication and scalar implicature as reasoning about a speaker who reasons about a listener.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is the web book's Social cognition chapter (prelude on assembly lines; inferring goals, preferences, knowledge and beliefs; emotion; communication and language; planning), with the OCW course's description of theory of mind as a target domain for context.
